description: OAuth 2.0 connection to NxtSend's shared authorization server. Scopes make.read / make.write (no make.send tier exists).
label: NxtSend OAuth 2.0
notes: Replace <your-domain> with the deployment origin (e.g. https://nxtsend.com).

BLOCKED until the coordinator extends src/lib/muse-connector/oauth/clients.ts: DCR currently refuses a make.* registration, so no client_id/client_secret can be issued for this resource yet. See docs/integrations/providers/automation-make.md.

PKCE: Make's OAuth 2.0 connection sends no PKCE by default; the NxtSend server requires PKCE only for public clients — a confidential Make client (client secret present) is exempt, same rule as Zapier.
